C1178.title: SoundCloud Data Breach Listed by HIBP as Affecting About 29.8 Million Accounts
C1178.summary: In December 2025, SoundCloud identified unauthorized activity on its platform. Have I Been Pwned later listed about 29.8 million affected accounts, with exposed data including email addresses, names, usernames, avatars, locations, and follower statistics. The attackers later attempted to extort SoundCloud and released the data the following month. SoundCloud said passwords and financial data were not involved.
